# Khan Academy

> Free online learning platform offering practice exercises, instructional videos, and teacher tools across math, science, computing, test prep, and more.

Khan Academy provides standards-aligned courses, personalized practice, progress tracking, and classroom tools for learners, parents, and teachers. Its site includes subject libraries, SAT and AP prep, computing content, partner content, and support resources.

## Core Learning Subjects
- [Math](https://www.khanacademy.org/math): Math courses spanning early math through college-level topics and test preparation.
- [Science](https://www.khanacademy.org/science): Science courses covering biology, chemistry, physics, cosmology, and health-related topics.
- [Computing](https://www.khanacademy.org/computing): Programming, computer science, internet, and digital literacy lessons with interactive content.
- [Arts and humanities](https://www.khanacademy.org/humanities): History, civics, grammar, reading, music, and art history resources.
- [Economics](https://www.khanacademy.org/economics-finance-domain): Economics and finance lessons on markets, accounting, and personal finance.
- [Test prep](https://www.khanacademy.org/test-prep): Preparation resources for standardized exams including SAT, LSAT, and MCAT.
- [Life skills](https://www.khanacademy.org/college-careers-more): Practical learning on careers, personal finance, and everyday decision-making.

## Math Courses
- [Early math](https://www.khanacademy.org/math/early-math): Foundational counting, shapes, addition, subtraction, and place value for young learners.
- [Arithmetic](https://www.khanacademy.org/math/arithmetic): Core arithmetic topics including operations, fractions, decimals, and measurement.
- [Pre-algebra](https://www.khanacademy.org/math/pre-algebra): Introductory algebra concepts, ratios, exponents, and linear relationships.
- [Algebra 1](https://www.khanacademy.org/math/algebra): Equations, inequalities, functions, and graphing for first-year algebra.
- [Geometry](https://www.khanacademy.org/math/geometry): Plane geometry topics including congruence, similarity, circles, and proofs.
- [Algebra 2](https://www.khanacademy.org/math/algebra2): Polynomial, rational, exponential, logarithmic, and trigonometric functions.
- [Precalculus](https://www.khanacademy.org/math/precalculus): Advanced algebra, trigonometry, vectors, matrices, and analytic geometry.
- [Calculus](https://www.khanacademy.org/math/calculus-1): Differential and integral calculus with applications and worked examples.

## Science Courses
- [Biology](https://www.khanacademy.org/science/biology): Cell biology, genetics, evolution, ecology, and organismal systems.
- [Chemistry](https://www.khanacademy.org/science/chemistry): Atomic structure, bonding, reactions, stoichiometry, and thermodynamics.
- [Physics](https://www.khanacademy.org/science/physics): Mechanics, forces, energy, waves, electricity, and magnetism.
- [Organic chemistry](https://www.khanacademy.org/science/organic-chemistry): Structure, nomenclature, reactions, and mechanisms in organic chemistry.
- [Cosmology and astronomy](https://www.khanacademy.org/science/cosmology-and-astronomy): Space science topics from planets to the large-scale universe.
- [Health and medicine](https://www.khanacademy.org/science/health-and-medicine): Human body systems, diseases, and medical science fundamentals.

## Computing and Digital Skills
- [Computer programming](https://www.khanacademy.org/computing/computer-programming): Interactive programming lessons using JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and SQL.
- [Computer science](https://www.khanacademy.org/computing/computer-science): Core computing concepts including algorithms, cryptography, and information theory.
- [Pixar in a Box](https://www.khanacademy.org/computing/pixar): Video lessons on animation, storytelling, and production from Pixar.
- [Hour of Code](https://www.khanacademy.org/hourofcode): Introductory coding activities designed for beginners and classrooms.
- [Internet 101](https://www.khanacademy.org/computing/computer-science/internet-intro): Lessons explaining how the internet works and key web concepts.

## Humanities, Economics, and Test Prep
- [US history](https://www.khanacademy.org/humanities/us-history): Survey of American history from early settlement through modern eras.
- [World history](https://www.khanacademy.org/humanities/world-history): Global historical developments, civilizations, and major turning points.
- [US government and civics](https://www.khanacademy.org/humanities/us-government-and-civics): Foundations of government, institutions, rights, and civic participation.
- [Grammar](https://www.khanacademy.org/humanities/grammar): English grammar, usage, punctuation, and sentence structure practice.
- [Microeconomics](https://www.khanacademy.org/economics-finance-domain/microeconomics): Consumer choice, firms, markets, and economic decision-making.
- [Macroeconomics](https://www.khanacademy.org/economics-finance-domain/macroeconomics): National income, inflation, unemployment, growth, and monetary policy.
- [Official Digital SAT Prep](https://www.khanacademy.org/test-prep/v2-sat-math): Official SAT practice and instruction for math and related skills.
- [LSAT](https://www.khanacademy.org/test-prep/lsat): Free LSAT preparation with practice questions and strategy lessons.

## Learners, Parents, and Teachers
- [Teachers](https://www.khanacademy.org/khan-for-educators): Classroom tools, assignments, progress tracking, and implementation resources for educators.
- [Parents](https://www.khanacademy.org/parent): Parent resources for supporting learning and monitoring student progress.
- [Learners](https://www.khanacademy.org/learners): Guidance for students using Khan Academy independently or with classes.
- [Districts](https://www.khanacademy.org/districts): Information for school systems adopting Khan Academy at scale.
- [Class code sign-up](https://www.khanacademy.org/signup?isteacher=1): Teacher-oriented sign-up flow for creating classes and assigning work.

## Support and Help Center
- [Help Center home](https://support.khanacademy.org/hc/en-us): Support portal for troubleshooting, account help, and product guidance.
- [Khan Academy Help Community](https://support.khanacademy.org/hc/en-us/community/topics): Community discussions and questions about using the platform.
- [Submit a request](https://support.khanacademy.org/hc/en-us/requests/new): Contact form for reporting issues or requesting support.
- [Teacher resources](https://support.khanacademy.org/hc/en-us/sections/200173197-Teachers): Help articles focused on classroom setup and teacher workflows.
- [Parents and students](https://support.khanacademy.org/hc/en-us/sections/200173187-Parents-and-students): Help articles for learner accounts, assignments, and progress.
- [Khanmigo support](https://support.khanacademy.org/hc/en-us/sections/18522621873421-Khanmigo): Support documentation for Khanmigo features and access.
